title: Update status prompt
summary: document.querySelector Finds the first matching element based on the selector. Assigning a value to textContent of this element will update the text in it.
tasks: Use document.querySelector to find #status in script.js.
changes its textContent to the text saved in the variable message.
hint: can use const status = document.querySelector('#status') to save elements.
goal: Finds the specified status element and replaces its text with the message in the script.

example.code:
const sign = document.querySelector('#arrival-message');
sign.textContent = 'train has arrived at the station';
example.note: platform information screen uses the element with the id of arrival-message to display the latest arrival message.
